clock_width_definition: 50% crossings; plateau plus one edge gives a 2 ns high interval
output_buffer_view: Two SAR_DRIVE/transistor stages with scale 1 and 2, following each output register

noise.basis: 50 GHz includes the sampling and regeneration bandwidths and exceeds the 17.5 GHz edge bandwidth associated with the fixed 20 ps clock transition; folding is retained. No manual integration-step or accuracy override is used.
